name: fig1_velocity_profiles
caption: Lamb-Oseen, Rankine, and potential vortex velocity profiles. The Lamb-Oseen vortex has a smooth core with peak velocity at r ≈ 1.12 r_c.

name: fig2_pressure_profiles
caption: Normalized pressure deficit in Lamb-Oseen and Rankine vortices. The Lamb-Oseen vortex has Δp = ρΓ²ln2/(4π²r_c²) ≈ 0.693 × Rankine value.

name: fig3_mccormick_scaling
caption: Cavitation inception number scaling: (left) σ_i vs dimensionless circulation Γ/(Vc), (right) σ_i vs Reynolds number. McCormick (1962): σ_i ∝ (Γ/Vc)^{2/3} Re^{-1/6}.

name: fig4_core_growth
caption: Tip vortex core radius growth by viscous diffusion: r_c(x) = √(r_c0² + 4νx/V). Larger initial cores grow more slowly (relative).
